description: Department of Labour - Notify the Cost of Living Index for the Cocoa, Cardamom & Paper Growing Trade.
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in specific trades (cocoa, cardamom, and pepper) based on the Cost of Living Index Number. It falls under public sector services and administration as it deals with wage regulations, worker benefits, and service conditions, which are characteristic of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8). The notification is issued by the Commissioner General of Labour under the Wages Boards Ordinance, further confirming its nature as a public service administrative matter rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
